scoring_point: pre-update prediction; event t feedback can only affect later predictions
accuracy: 1[argmax probability equals exact target], ties choose lowest canonical index
calibration: 10 fixed-width bins over max probability; report count, mean confidence, empirical accuracy, ECE and reliability curve
temporal_curves: Event-level and change-aligned curves, with paired world seed and arm identity preserved
criterion: At least 7 correct in the latest 8 scored events for the affected key set; first eligible step after a regime change. Never reached is right-censored at the world end.
samples_to_criterion: Number of scored affected-key events from first changed-regime query through first criterion window, inclusive; right-censored if absent.
switch_latency: Scored events from true switch to first criterion, right-censored if absent.
return_recovery_latency: Same latency at B-to-A return; report separately from first A-to-B switch.
retention_unaffected_keys: Mean pre-update accuracy on keys whose exact world-state target did not change across the transition, before versus after transition; report denominator.
false_update_rate: Fraction of contradictory-noise feedback opportunities followed by a changed predicted class on next occurrence of the same key while truth is unchanged; report opportunity count.
poison_persistence: Number of subsequent same-key scored events after poison burst end until first correct prediction, right-censored if absent.
